host.frequency_policy: shared cloud host; no frequency pinning

workload.payload_bytes_per_s_definition: 500 * 100 payload bytes divided by decoded batch time; excludes keys, headers and wire overhead

method.estimator: Median of five Criterion mean point estimates; paired median throughput ratios with percentile bootstrap 95% CI

limits: All results local and unsigned; shared-host wall-clock timing does not qualify a controlled benchmark campaign.
